paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.54 as of October 26, 2026, with a change of -4.15% from the prior close and -40.38% over the last 20 sessions.

There are no new news headlines in the last 24 hours, but recent news includes a report from The Motley Fool on October 13, 2026, stating that Fermi's stock surged 14% due to AMD's credit support for Project Matador.

Fermi Inc. has filed several recent forms with the SEC, including a Form 4 on October 22, 2026, and a Form 144 on October 20, 2026, as well as an 8-K form on October 16, 2026, announcing an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd.
